objective: Verify the candidate rejects or explicitly excludes invalid geometry without inventing an odata status convention.
observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the validation and error-return paths.
pass_condition: Pass iff the candidate either rejects invalid geometry before kernel launch with a host-observable error, or documents those invocations as outside the contract; and odata is never used as an error-status channel.
setup: Inspect the future Ascend-C candidate host wrapper for pre-launch validation of width>0, height>0, and pitch>=width, and inspect the kernel return type and odata usage.
